tasks.final_text: I recently took a quiz for my STATs class. It reminded me how studying might have been better with smaller chuncks over time, instead of what I did which was cram the night before and morning of. Also, how I cannot sleep before a test. I am looking to change.

The 1954 Allantic hurricane season was an above-average Atlantic hurricane season in terms of named storms, with 16 forming. Overall, the season resulted n $751.6 million in damage, the most of any season at the time. The season officailly began on June 15, and nine days later the first named storm developed.
